description: Slash commands exposed by RedOps skills for supported CLI clients.

commands.name: redops-rag
commands.content: Use the RedOps RAG skill for this task. Start with retrieval, cite returned source paths/URLs, and never claim a command ran unless its output is present. Keep testing limited to written scope and use `redops exegol exec -- <argv...>` only after authorization and container checks.

commands.name: mobile-vuln-hunt
commands.content: Load and follow the `mobile-vuln-hunt` skill for this task. Restrict work to authorized Android/iOS artifacts and disposable lab devices; begin with static analysis and cite RedOps knowledge sources.

commands.name: reverse-engineer
commands.description: Static reverse-engineering workflow for authorized artifacts.
commands.content: Load and follow the `reverse-engineer` skill for this task. Preserve input hashes, work on copies, and do not execute unknown samples on the host. Use Exegol or bounded tools when runtime analysis is explicitly authorized.

commands.name: afl-fuzzing
commands.content: Load and follow the `afl-fuzzing` skill for this task. Fuzz only an authorized disposable Android emulator/device, validate harness reachability with a positive control, and stop when the device or scope is unavailable.
